form.label: BigFix Remote Control Health & Security
form.description: Monitors TRC server LDAP syncs, Broker heartbeats, user session activity, and configuration errors.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:rc:trc" "LDAP: Total execution time" | rex "was (?<minutes>\d+) Minutes (?<seconds>[\d\.]+) Seconds" | eval duration_secs = (minutes * 60) + seconds | timechart avg(duration_secs) AS "Avg Sync Duration (s)" max(duration_secs) AS "Max Sync Duration (s)"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:rc:trc" "Broker HeartBeat" | rex "from \[(?<broker_name>[^\]]+)\] Version \[(?<version>[^\]]+)\]" | stats count AS "Heartbeat Count", latest(_time) AS "Last Heartbeat" by broker_name, version | fieldformat "Last Heartbeat" = strftime('Last Heartbeat', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename broker_name AS "Broker Name", version AS "TRC Version" | sort - "Last Heartbeat"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:rc:trc" ("LiteWebPortal Login" OR "Session rejected") | eval action = if(match(_raw, "LiteWebPortal Login"), "Successful Login", "Session Rejected / Timeout") | rex "User \[(?<user>[^\]]+)\]" | eval user = coalesce(user, "System/Unknown") | stats count AS "Events", latest(_time) AS "Latest Event Timestamp" by action, user | fieldformat "Latest Event Timestamp" = strftime('Latest Event Timestamp', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename action AS "Session Event", user AS "Account" | sort - "Latest Event Timestamp"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:rc:trc" ERROR | rex "\[ERROR\]\s+-\s+(?<error_message>.*)" | eval error_message=coalesce(error_message, _raw) | stats count AS "Occurrences", latest(_time) AS "Latest Occurrence" by error_message | fieldformat "Latest Occurrence" = strftime('Latest Occurrence', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename error_message AS "Error Message" | sort - Occurrences
